title: metadata: the save door and the package publish door accept a package id that is not installed (object, dashboard, page …), storing and even publishing items into a phantom package; Studio renders a writable builder for it
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A metadata save naming a package that does not exist is accepted, both as a draft and as an active save, and `publish-drafts` on that phantom id publishes. With no manifest there is no namespace, so the namespace-prefix gate is skipped. The phantom package then shows up in stats. The flow door already refuses this (#20863 / PR #20959); the other types do not. In Studio, `/_console/studio/<nonexistent-package>` renders a full writable builder (New object, Create app) instead of "package not found", and an unknown pillar segment falls through to Interfaces.

## Reproduction

1. As admin: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/ghost_two?mode=draft&package=com.example.nosuch2` body `{"name":"ghost_two","label":"Ghost Two","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name"}}}` → 200 "Saved object … package=com.example.nosuch2, state=draft".
2. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.nosuch2` → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
3. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.nosuch2/publish-drafts` → 200 `outcome:"published"`; `GET /api/v1/meta/object/ghost_two` → 200 live, unprefixed.
4. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_ghost_obj?package=com.example.nosuch3` (no mode) → 200 "state=active". Same for dashboard and page bodies.
5. Browser: `/_console/studio/com.example.nosuch` → writable builder with package chip; `/_console/studio/<pkg>/bogus_pillar` → Interfaces pillar, nothing highlighted.

## Expected

Every save and publish door refuses an uninstalled package the way the flow door does (422 naming that no package with that id is installed), and Studio shows a "package not found" state for an unknown package or pillar.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

The `/meta` save door package resolution and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` publish-drafts (the flow-only refusal from PR #20959 generalised to every type); Studio `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` package/pillar resolution.

## Filing facts

- reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/…` and `POST /api/v1/packages/…/publish-drafts` measured as admin; Studio URL measured in the browser.
- Business reason: A typo in a package id silently creates live, unnamespaced metadata owned by nothing — it cannot be uninstalled or exported as a package, and it bypasses the namespace rule.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:server`, `area:studio`, p1.
- Dedupe: semantic search `metadata save accepts package that is not installed, publish-drafts on nonexistent package` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 41 hits; related closed #20863 (flow door only) and #24547 (namespace prefix on active save); no open duplicate.
- QA id: F3
